environment.description: Same Ktor service deployed on EKS with Istio service mesh. The mesh has a PeerAuthentication policy requiring mTLS STRICT mode cluster-wide. An AuthorizationPolicy resource scoped to the service's workload applies a DENY action for any request where the source principal does not match 'cluster.local/ns/sre-tools/sa/diagnostics-reader' AND the request path matches prefix '/internal/'. Additionally, the pod runs with an ephemeral-storage limit of 64Mi and a Vertical Pod Autoscaler with memory ceiling of 384Mi with OOMKill policy, combined with a Prometheus alertmanager rule firing on container_memory_working_set_bytes > 300Mi for 2m that triggers a HPA scale-to-zero followed by rollout restart. pgBouncer is configured with server_lifetime=300 and application_name_add_host=1 for connection attribution.

config.istio_authz_policy: DENY requests to /internal/* unless source principal matches cluster.local/ns/sre-tools/sa/diagnostics-reader
config.prometheus_alert: container_memory_working_set_bytes > 300Mi for 2m triggers scale-to-zero + rollout restart
